data.name: Rem Survival
data.detailed_description:
Survive the collapse. Every choice matters.

REM Survival is a post-apocalyptic survival experience where exploration, crafting, and progression are key. Play solo or online in co-op, PvE, or PvP as you scavenge resources, build dynamic bases, craft weapons and vehicles, and survive a hostile world filled with mutated enemies, radiation zones, and forgotten technology. Manage hunger, thirst, temperature, and skills while farming, cooking, researching lost tech, completing quests, and competing for high-value airdrops in a living world with dynamic weather and day-night cycles.

This is survival stripped back to its raw core.

What Makes REM Surivial Different

  • Brutal survival systems
    Manage hunger, thirst, stamina, temperature, and health in a world that does not forgive careless decisions.

  • Crafting from trash & salvage
    Turn broken, discarded materials into tools, armor, and survival equipment. Every item has value—nothing is useless.

  • Harsh consequences
    Poor planning can cost you everything. Death is punishing, and survival means learning from failure.

  • Atmospheric post-apocalyptic world
    Explore a desolate environment filled with abandoned structures, decaying technology, and environmental hazards.

  • Progression through mastery
    Start weak and vulnerable. Become efficient, prepared, and capable through experience—not hand-holding.

Play Your Way — But Pay the Price

There are no scripted solutions.
No guaranteed safety.
No easy mode survival.

Whether you build a secure shelter, roam endlessly for loot, or live on the edge scavenging high-risk locations, every decision shapes how long you survive.

Who This Game Is For

✔ Fans of hardcore survival games
✔ Players who enjoy slow, tense, atmospheric gameplay
✔ Gamers who prefer systems over hand-holding
✖ Not recommended for players looking for fast action or casual survival

Core Features

  • Multiple Game Modes
    Play solo or with others in locally or dedicated hosted Single-player, Co-op, PvE, and PvP modes.

  • Crafting System
    Build workbenches and use specialized tools to unlock recipes and increase crafting success.

  • Vehicle Construction
    Design, build, and drive your own vehicles using scavenged parts.

  • Character Skills & Attributes
    Level up survival skills and stats to adapt your playstyle and increase survivability.

  • Dynamic Base Building
    Construct and upgrade bases using multiple material tiers for defense and utility.

  • Dynamic Weather System
    Experience changing weather conditions including thunderstorms, fog, and light rain.

  • Weapon Attachments
    Customize weapons with red-dot sights and other attachments to improve combat effectiveness.

  • Resource Harvesting
    Gather a wide variety of resources from the environment to craft, build, and survive.

  • Hostile NPCs
    Encounter wildlife, mutated humans, and elite enemy types throughout the world.

  • Farming System
    Grow food using garden beds, compost bins, and greenhouses.

  • Cooking System
    Prepare meals using campfires, stoves, pots, and grills to sustain your character.

  • Smelting & Refining
    Process raw materials using furnaces, progressing from stone to iron.

  • Day & Night Cycle
    A full world cycle that affects visibility, temperature, and gameplay.

  • Survival Needs
    Manage hunger, thirst, stamina, and thermal conditions to stay alive.

  • Dynamic Temperature System
    Temperature changes based on time of day and seasonal conditions.

  • Clothing & Gadgets
    Equip clothing and gadgets that affect protection, temperature, and utility.

  • Clan System
    Form clans to share base access, items, and collaborate with other players.

  • Power Construction
    Connect to an existing power grid or generate and manage your own power systems.

  • Quest System
    Discover random loot quests across the island to earn valuable rewards.

  • Airdrop Events
    Compete for high-value airdrops with three different loot tiers.

  • Dynamic Loot Spawns
    Explore towns and forests with randomized loot locations each playthrough.

  • Radiation Zones & Bunkers
    Enter dangerous radiation areas and underground bunkers for rare loot and secrets.

  • Blueprints & Schematics
    Find and learn blueprints to unlock advanced crafting and building options.

  • Research System
    Recover forgotten technology and essential items needed to survive in a broken world.

DISCLAIMER (PLEASE READ)

Early Access is intended for those interested in supporting the project and participating in its continued development. You will most likely experience balancing issues, performance issues, latency issues, bugs and incomplete features. I will try my best to target latency issues to improve the quality of online gameplay the best I can. If you are looking for a complete gaming experience this may not be for you, I would recommend watching some recent YouTube videos showing the current state of the game. Rem Survival has been solely developed by myself, and I've always taken passion in working on it, I feel this is important to mention, so those considering purchasing Early Access can make a more informed decision.

Goals of the project:

The aim was to create a game that wasn't overly complicated but also provided a strategy-based experience that offered challenges and an overall goal and purpose to playing, rather than just looting and shooting. I wanted the game to be as balanced as possible in PvP while also offering decent PvE content.

data.short_description: Scavenge abandoned ruins, craft gear from scrap and salvaged materials, and fight the environment itself as hunger, exposure, and exhaustion push you to your limits. There are no second chances—only adaptation or death.

content_descriptors.notes: In-game characters start off nude and need to find or craft clothing. However, it’s the player's choice if they want to wear clothes or not. As for violence, players do go head-to-head in order to survive against each other and the game's AI characters, which includes some mild blood effects.

reviews.review:
Rem Survival is a demanding open-world survival experience built around the idea that staying alive should require constant planning rather than simply defeating enemies. Developed and published by Immortal Hand Studios, it drops players into a hostile post-apocalyptic setting where food, water, shelter, equipment, and environmental protection are fundamental concerns. The game favors a methodical pace, with progression emerging from learning how its various survival systems interact. Instead of immediately turning the player into a powerful wasteland warrior, it emphasizes vulnerability and gradually rewards those willing to gather resources, establish a secure home, and prepare carefully before venturing into dangerous territory.

Basic survival management forms the foundation of the experience. Hunger, thirst, health, stamina, and temperature need regular attention, while changing weather and the day-and-night cycle can make otherwise routine journeys considerably more dangerous. Clothing and equipment therefore serve practical purposes beyond appearance, particularly when dealing with environmental conditions. These mechanics encourage players to think ahead before leaving their shelter. Carrying sufficient supplies, wearing appropriate protection, and deciding how far to explore become meaningful considerations because a successful scavenging trip can quickly become a desperate attempt to return home alive.

Crafting gives collected materials long-term importance. Resources recovered from abandoned areas can be transformed into tools, equipment, weapons, armor, building components, and other useful items. Workbenches expand what can be manufactured, while blueprints, schematics, research, smelting, and refining provide additional progression paths. Discovering forgotten technology is especially useful because exploration is not merely about finding another pile of basic supplies. Dangerous locations may contain knowledge or materials capable of improving the player's overall capabilities, giving increasingly hazardous expeditions a stronger sense of purpose.

Base construction is one of the more substantial parts of Rem Survival. Players can begin with relatively modest protection and gradually develop a more capable settlement using improved construction materials and equipment. Electricity adds another level of development through power connections and generation systems. Farming also supports greater independence, with garden beds, composting, and greenhouse options helping establish renewable sources of food. Cooking complements these mechanics through different preparation methods, turning a base into something more meaningful than a storage location. A well-developed settlement represents accumulated survival progress and can significantly reduce dependence on constant scavenging for basic necessities.

The world outside that shelter provides the game's primary source of danger. Hostile wildlife, mutated humans, stronger elite enemies, radiation, abandoned buildings, bunkers, and other hazardous areas create a range of threats. Radiation zones in particular encourage specialized preparation instead of allowing players to enter every location with the same equipment. Loot distribution contains randomized elements, helping maintain some uncertainty when revisiting the environment. Airdrops offer another source of valuable supplies and can become especially tense in multiplayer because other survivors may have exactly the same objective.

Combat is integrated into the broader survival structure rather than being the sole attraction. Firearms and equipment can be improved, including the use of weapon attachments, while character attributes and skills develop over time. The availability of single-player, cooperative, PvE, and PvP approaches gives players some flexibility in deciding what kind of survival experience they want. Cooperative groups can form clans, share access to resources and bases, and divide responsibilities, whereas PvP introduces the additional danger of unpredictable human opponents. Solo players can instead concentrate on exploration, building, resource management, and surviving against environmental and AI-controlled threats.

Vehicles expand exploration and provide another worthwhile progression objective. Rather than simply receiving transportation immediately, players can work toward assembling usable vehicles from scavenged components. This fits naturally with the game's overall philosophy of earning convenience through survival and crafting. Quests, character progression, research, farming, construction, vehicles, airdrops, exploration, and randomized loot collectively provide objectives beyond merely surviving another day. The strongest moments come when these systems overlap, such as preparing supplies at a self-sufficient base before driving toward a dangerous location in search of rare technology.

The atmosphere benefits from its ruined environments and unpredictable conditions. Fog, storms, rain, darkness, abandoned structures, dangerous underground locations, radiation, and hostile creatures reinforce the impression of an unforgiving world. There can be long periods where gathering and traveling dominate the experience, so players expecting nonstop action may find the pacing slow. For survival enthusiasts, however, that downtime is part of the appeal because it makes preparation and resource security meaningful rather than treating them as secondary mechanics.

Its Early Access nature remains an important consideration. The number of interconnected mechanics is ambitious, but that ambition can also produce rough edges, including uneven balancing, technical problems, performance inconsistencies, and systems that may not feel completely refined. The harsh survival structure can also punish mistakes severely, which will appeal more to players who enjoy learning through failure than those seeking a forgiving sandbox. Rem Survival has an impressive mechanical foundation, but patience with its unfinished qualities is advisable.

Steam Deck compatibility is officially categorized as Playable rather than fully Verified. Performance with the default graphics configuration is considered suitable, and the game can run successfully on SteamOS. However, handheld players should expect compromises. Some functionality is not fully accessible through the default controller configuration, touchscreen interaction or a community controller layout may occasionally be useful, and text entry can require manually opening the virtual keyboard. Some interface text may also appear small, while certain prompts can display keyboard, mouse, or non-Steam Deck controller icons. It is therefore functional on the Deck, but the experience is less seamless than a fully optimized handheld release.

Taken as a whole, Rem Survival offers a substantial survival sandbox for players attracted to crafting, construction, exploration, resource management, environmental hazards, farming, research, vehicles, cooperative play, and PvP. Its greatest advantage is how many of these mechanics contribute toward the same satisfying progression from vulnerable scavenger to increasingly self-sufficient survivor. The unfinished presentation and demanding nature prevent it from being universally recommendable, but its depth gives dedicated survival fans plenty to experiment with.

Rating: 7/10
